name: us9-hook-registration
description: 003 T020 — The configuration ceremony VERIFIES the lifecycle hooks and never writes them. The fixture carries the registry exactly as `specify extension add` produces it: PyYAML block style, sequences at their parent key's indentation, the canonical EIGHT-field entry per event (extension, command, enabled, optional, priority, prompt, description, condition), a foreign extension's entry under after_plan, and operator comments. It replaces the old four-field shape this extension used to write itself. Both ports must produce a byte-identical post-run workdir — which includes .specify/extensions.yml, so a re-serialisation by either port fails the diff — and an identical --json summary reporting the hooks effect as `healthy` (003 FR-021, FR-022, FR-023, SC-007, SC-012). Before/after byte-identity against the seed is asserted directly in tests/bash/commands/test_registry_never_written.bats and its Pester twin.
